description: This file defines a RecyclerView Adapter called ProductAdapter that manages the display of Product items in a list within an Android UI. It handles binding product data to UI elements and user interactions such as clicking on a product or adding it to a cart.

classes.name: ProductAdapter
classes.description: A RecyclerView Adapter for displaying Product items, managing item views, and handling user interactions.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Updates the adapter's items list with new Product data and refreshes the display.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a new ViewHolder instance by inflating the item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds Product data to a ViewHolder at the specified position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of Product items.

methods.name: VH
methods.description: Inner class ViewHolder that manages individual item views and binds data to UI components.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Assigns Product data to TextViews and sets up click listeners for item interaction.
